summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for cipher-box Phase 68 (rotation UX + durable client state), producing research, pattern-mapping, plan files, and a passing verification, then correct course after the user flagged a testing-strategy violation.
summary.outcome: Research, pattern mapping, and 9 plans across 3 waves were generated and verified (0 blockers, 3 minor warnings, 2 fixed inline); coverage gates (requirements, decisions, post-planning gap analysis) all passed and work was committed. The user then caught that the plans violated project testing doctrine (unit-testing apps/web instead of hoisting logic to the SDK and using e2e for UI), so VALIDATION.md was rewritten and a re-plan of all 9 plans was kicked off but not yet complete when the transcript ends.

repo: cipher-box testing doctrine (docs/TESTING.md): apps/web UI is not unit tested — all core logic must live in the SDK (Vitest unit tests) and the web UI is exercised only via Playwright e2e (tests/web-e2e/).

apps/web actually has a vitest config and ~10 existing *.test.ts files (services/stores/hooks), but they are NOT part of the CI unit-test gate list or coverage-threshold table — the docs and the on-disk reality have drifted apart, so doctrine must be checked against actual CI gates, not just the presence of test files.
Rotation logic must be wired into packages/sdk/src/client.ts mutation methods (renameItem, moveItem, deleteItem, deleteToBin), not into the thin web React hooks that merely call client.X().
No `idb` npm package is used anywhere in the repo; new IndexedDB stores must follow the hand-rolled raw-indexedDB Promise-wrapping pattern already used in identity.ts / search-index.service.ts.

New apps/api PATCH routes should mirror the existing updateShareItemName/UpdateItemNameDto pattern (ownership check via sharerId, class-validator decorators, HttpCode(204)) and require running `pnpm api:generate` afterward.

GSD commit-wrapper Bash calls repeatedly report a false-negative `commit_failed` even when lint-staged succeeds and the commit lands cleanly — must verify via `git log`/`git status` rather than trusting the reported exit status.

`fetchReceivedShares`/`fetchSentShares` in share.service.ts are stub functions that unconditionally throw, and `reMintGrantsRootedAt`'s `updateGrantFn` has no backing API endpoint — both are real, previously-undocumented scope gaps for any rotation/sharing work.

code.finding: Existing anti-clobber sequenceNumber guard that Phase 68 rotation work needs to reuse with inverted polarity (per D-04).
renameItem — a chokepoint where rotation must be wired in, not in web hooks.
moveItem — a chokepoint where rotation must be wired in, not in web hooks.
deleteItem — a chokepoint where rotation must be wired in, not in web hooks.
deleteToBin — a chokepoint where rotation must be wired in, not in web hooks.
Configured with `include: ['src/**/*.test.ts']` and `environment: 'node'` — no IndexedDB test shim exists, and per corrected doctrine apps/web shouldn't be growing new unit tests here at all.

workflow: The GSD plan-phase pipeline runs research → validation-strategy → drift check → pattern-mapper → planner → plan-checker → coverage gates (requirements, decisions, post-planning gap analysis), each as a separate subagent spawn with an explicit 'runs in a subagent' liveness notice per ui-brand.md conventions.

Plan-checker warnings can be triaged live: cheap, unambiguous ones (missing depends_on entry, doc-hygiene marker) get fixed immediately; ones tied to future execution state (VALIDATION.md frontmatter flags) are correctly deferred rather than force-fixed.

When a spawned agent's output contradicts documented project doctrine, it's worth pausing to persist the correction as a durable memory before re-spawning the fix, so the mistake isn't repeated in future sessions.

friction: Bash commit-wrapper calls reported `commit_failed` at least three times (VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md, planning finalization) when the commits had actually succeeded, requiring manual git-status verification each time.
The decision-coverage gate produced no output on first run and had to be re-run to get a usable result.

The planner's first pass (232k tokens, ~26 min) produced 9 plans that violated the project's core testing doctrine — apps/web unit tests plus a fake-indexeddb shim — because the doctrine (docs/TESTING.md) wasn't consulted or referenced during research/pattern-mapping, wasting a full planning cycle and requiring a full re-plan.

RESEARCH.md and PATTERNS.md both surfaced real scope gaps (throwing share.service stubs, missing apps/api grant-update endpoint) not present in the original CONTEXT.md, expanding the phase's blast radius mid-flow.
open_items: Re-planning of all 9 Phase 68 plans to match the corrected testing doctrine (SDK-hoisted logic, e2e-only UI testing) was in progress (planner subagent spawned) but not completed by end of transcript.
Plan-checker and coverage gates (requirements/decisions/post-planning gap analysis) need to be re-run once the corrected plans are produced.
VALIDATION.md frontmatter (nyquist_compliant, wave_0_complete) and Approval status still need reconciliation once Wave 0 actually completes (deferred per checker's warning #3).

Whether to add dedicated Playwright e2e coverage for the rotation flows (badge lifecycle, reload-resume, fail-closed toast) as part of Phase 68 or as a separate follow-up phase remains an open decision the user hasn't finalized.

The mismatch between apps/web's existing ~10 *.test.ts files and their absence from CI's unit-test gate/coverage-threshold table was noted but not resolved — worth reconciling docs vs. CI config separately.
